Sindhi College, established in 2002, is built on a sprawling two acres of land at Hebbal, Kempapura,
with an imposing multi-storied building providing
all facilities conducive for ideal
learning. The CLASSROOMS, LABORATORIES, LIBRARY, AUDITORIUM, GOLDEN JUBILEE HALL
& INDOOR STADIUM leave an alluring impression and bring in the feeling of an exemplary
educational institution.
The sponsors Sindhi Seva Samiti is a philanthropic organisation set up by a group of elite
Sindhians of Bangalore. They have never left a stone unturned in their pursuit of excellence
and consider providing this wealth of education which surpasses all benefits, material
riches can provide.
We are sure that a visit to our college will be a lasting memory to all of you.
